frame: Panel frame: origin at the panel upper-left corner seen from the front, X across (right), Y down, mm. KiCad sheet position = kicad_origin + panel XY.
rail_note: Rail holes sit 1 HP off the Doepfer 7.5 mm phase, as every module (12.58 mm; 2.42 mm on 2 HP, case/tools/build_case.py), so they land on the 2 HP case spacer grid. 8 HP has a second hole pair 4 HP right (32.9), as modules/acid.
